title: Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)
shortDesc: Protect secret ideas, code, client lists, and business plans
shortDesc_hi: व्यापारिक जानकारी, कोड और व्यापारिक विचारों की सुरक्षा

questions.label: Sharing Party (Person / Company sharing secrets)
questions.label_hi: गोपनीय जानकारी साझा करने वाला (कंपनी / व्यक्ति)
questions.placeholder: e.g. Acme Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd
questions.placeholder_hi: उदा. एक्मे टेक सॉल्यूशंस प्राइवेट लिमिटेड
questions.hint: Name of the entity disclosing confidential data
questions.hint_hi: जो पक्ष अपनी जानकारी साझा कर रहा है

questions.label: Receiving Party (Person / Company getting secrets)
questions.hint: Name of the partner, consultant, or collaborator

questions.label: Purpose of Sharing Information
questions.placeholder: e.g. Evaluating software partnership and designing mobile app architecture
questions.placeholder_hi: उदा. सॉफ्टवेयर साझेदारी एवं मोबाइल ऐप विकास पर चर्चा
questions.hint: State clearly why you are sharing this information
questions.hint_hi: स्पष्ट लिखें कि जानकारी किस कार्य हेतु दी जा रही है

questions.label: Confidentiality Duration (in Years)
questions.hint: Typically 2 to 3 years from the date of disclosure
questions.hint_hi: आमतौर पर भारत में 2 से 3 वर्ष की अवधि रखी जाती है

questions.label: Governing City for Dispute Resolution
questions.hint: The courts of this city will handle any legal disputes
questions.hint_hi: किसी विवाद की स्थिति में इस शहर की अदालतें मान्य होंगी

clauses.title: Parties to the NDA
clauses.plain: This agreement is between {disclosingParty} (Disclosing Party) and {receivingParty} (Receiving Party).
clauses.legal: THIS NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT is made between {disclosingParty} (hereinafter referred to as the 'Discloser') AND {receivingParty} (hereinafter referred to as the 'Recipient').
clauses.note: Verify company registration number or individual government ID.
clauses.note_hi: कंपनी का CIN या व्यक्ति का आधार/पैन अवश्य सत्यापित करें।

clauses.title: What is Confidential
clauses.plain: Confidential information includes all business plans, software code, customer data, pricing, designs, and notes shared between the parties.
clauses.legal: Confidential Information shall comprise all proprietary technical, financial, and business data, algorithms, source codes, customer lists, and trade secrets disclosed either orally or in documentary form.
clauses.note: Mark critical emails and documents with 'CONFIDENTIAL'.

clauses.title: Obligations to Keep Secret
clauses.plain: The Receiving Party agrees to keep all shared information strictly secret. They will not share it with third parties and will only use it for: {purpose}.
clauses.legal: The Recipient covenants to hold all Confidential Information in strictest confidence, using not less than a reasonable degree of care, and shall use such materials exclusively for the Purpose of: {purpose}.
clauses.note: Never share secrets via unencrypted public channels.
clauses.note_hi: गोपनीय जानकारी कभी भी असुरक्षित माध्यमों से न भेजें।

clauses.title: Duration of Protection
clauses.plain: This duty to protect secrets will stay in effect for {durationYears} years from the date of disclosure.
clauses.legal: The non-disclosure and non-use covenants herein shall survive for a period of {durationYears} years following the effective date of execution.
clauses.note: Trade secrets can be protected indefinitely if specified.
clauses.note_hi: ट्रेड सीक्रेट्स को अनिश्चित काल तक सुरक्षित रखा जा सकता है।

clauses.title: Dispute Resolution & Jurisdiction
clauses.plain: This agreement follows the laws of India. If any dispute arises, the courts in {jurisdictionCity} will have exclusive authority.
clauses.legal: This agreement shall be governed and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of India. The competent courts in {jurisdictionCity} shall exercise exclusive territorial and subject-matter jurisdiction.
clauses.note: Choose the city where your primary business or residence is located.
clauses.note_hi: वही शहर चुनें जहां आपका मुख्य कार्यालय या निवास है।

warnings.title: Extended NDA Duration
warnings.message: NDAs exceeding 5 years without narrow trade secret definitions may face enforceability challenges under Section 27 of the Indian Contract Act (Restraint of Trade).
warnings.message_hi: 5 वर्ष से अधिक की सामान्य NDA भारतीय अनुबंध अधिनियम की धारा 27 के तहत चुनौतीपूर्ण हो सकती है।
warnings.action: A period between 2 to 3 years is market standard in India.
warnings.action_hi: भारत में 2 से 3 वर्ष की अवधि सबसे मानक मानी जाती है।
